name: mujoco_hopper_v0
description: Canonical MuJoCo Hopper continuous-control benchmark for validating generic RL autoresearch loops.
notes: Hopper is a standard MuJoCo locomotion benchmark with three torque-controlled hinges.
The bundled seed is intentionally simple SAC; serious baselines should compare against SB3 RL Zoo or CleanRL.
This task validates the simulator-agnostic harness on a widely recognized continuous-control environment.
The live dashboard samples RGB frames from the training process through the runner's MuJoCo renderer.
